title: Birth in 1916 next to Miss Abak Cole's house
summary: Breaux says he started music around 1928-29 and was born in New Orleans in 1916, next door to a well-known woman whose house he rented with his family.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Way down. That's, that's... When did you start in music? We might ask a few questions, even first when you were born and you were quite...
Well, uh, I started playing music, uh, in, uh, about 1928 or 29. I just don't remember exactly what year it was.
Well, I was born in 1916, August 11th. August 11th? Mm-hmm.

Were you born here in town?
That's right. In New Orleans? Yeah, I was born in New Orleans.
Miss Abak Cole's house. She's, uh, very well, well-noted during her days.

That's right. I was born next door to, I was born right next door to, we were renting from Miss Abak Cole.
